misprints.note: The print has a doubled comma after 'b'.
The full stop after the abbreviation 'm' is missing in the print.

uncertain.note: After the comma there is a raised dot. It could be a stray mark or a broken semicolon. I kept it as ',·'.
The diacritics on οἷον and ὥς are small and hard to tell apart (rough breathing with circumflex or acute, against a plain accent). I kept the earlier reading.
The breathing on ταὐτὰ is faint. It looks smooth (crasis), so I kept it as ταὐτὰ.
